package facadeconsumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/query"
)

type minimalBackend struct{}

func (*minimalBackend) Query(context.Context, query.Plan) (db.Rows, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (*minimalBackend) Insert(context.Context, query.InsertPlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (*minimalBackend) Update(context.Context, query.UpdatePlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (*minimalBackend) Delete(context.Context, query.DeletePlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

var (
	_ project.Backend = (*minimalBackend)(nil)
	_ project.Backend = (db.Session)(nil)
	_ project.Backend = (db.RelationSession)(nil)
)

func compileRelationFacade(ctx context.Context, backend project.Backend) error {
	models, err := project.Using(backend)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	authorQuery := models.AuthorsAuthor.
		Filter(authors.AuthorFields.Name.IContains("all authors")).
		OrderBy(authors.AuthorFields.ID.Asc())
	limitedAuthors, err := authorQuery.Limit(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	authorsResult, err := limitedAuthors.All(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var authorWrappers []*project.AuthorsAuthor = authorsResult
	_ = authorWrappers

	author, found, err := models.AuthorsAuthor.
		Filter(authors.AuthorFields.Name.IContains("author")).
		OrderBy(authors.AuthorFields.ID.Asc()).
		First(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if found {
		var authorWrapper *project.AuthorsAuthor = author
		authorModel, err := authorWrapper.Unwrap()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var rawAuthor authors.Author = authorModel
		_ = rawAuthor.ID
		_ = rawAuthor.Name
	}

	filtered := models.BlogPost.Filter(blog.PostFields.Title.IContains("lazy"))
	ordered := filtered.OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc())
	limited, err := ordered.Limit(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lazyPosts, err := limited.All(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var lazyWrappers []*project.BlogPost = lazyPosts
	_ = lazyWrappers

	post, found, err := models.BlogPost.
		OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc()).
		First(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !found {
		return nil
	}
	var source *project.BlogPost = post
	_ = source

	required, err := post.Author(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var requiredTarget *project.AuthorsAuthor = required
	_, err = requiredTarget.Unwrap()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	nullable, present, err := post.Reviewer(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if present {
		var nullableTarget *project.AuthorsAuthor = nullable
		_, err = nullableTarget.Unwrap()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	rawPost, err := post.Unwrap()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var model blog.Post = rawPost
	_ = model.ID
	_ = model.Title
	_ = model.AuthorID

	var selector project.BlogPostRelationSelector = models.BlogPost.Related.Author
	_ = selector
	selector = models.BlogPost.Related.Reviewer
	_ = selector

	authorEager := models.BlogPost.
		SelectRelated(models.BlogPost.Related.Author).
		Filter(blog.PostFields.Title.IContains("author eager")).
		OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc())
	limitedAuthorEager, err := authorEager.Limit(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	posts, err := limitedAuthorEager.All(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(posts) != 0 {
		var eagerSource *project.BlogPost = posts[0]
		_, err = eagerSource.Author(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	reviewerEager := models.BlogPost.
		Filter(blog.PostFields.Title.IContains("reviewer eager")).
		SelectRelated(models.BlogPost.Related.Reviewer).
		OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc())
	limitedReviewerEager, err := reviewerEager.Limit(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	posts, err = limitedReviewerEager.All(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(posts) == 0 {
		return err
	}
	_, _, err = posts[0].Reviewer(ctx)
	return err
}

func compileMinimalBackend(ctx context.Context, backend *minimalBackend) error {
	models, err := project.Using(backend)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, _, err = models.BlogPost.OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc()).First(ctx)
	return err
}

func compileSession(ctx context.Context, session db.Session) error {
	models, err := project.Using(session)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, _, err = models.AuthorsAuthor.OrderBy(authors.AuthorFields.ID.Asc()).First(ctx)
	return err
}

func compileRelationSession(ctx context.Context, session db.RelationSession) error {
	models, err := project.Using(session)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, _, err = models.BlogPost.OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc()).First(ctx)
	return err
}
